# `gno.land/r/moul/demo/gnoface/v0`

Generates a random ASCII/SVG "gno face" — a small generative-art demo realm.
Uses [`p/moul/entropy`](../../../../../p/moul/entropy/v0) for pseudo-randomness.
Educational / fun example (see [r/moul/demo](../../README.md)).
